sources.note: Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists Selectboard members Denise 'Dee' McDowell (term expiring 2026), Jeff Cota (2027), and Ted Gattino (2028).

Town of Barton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (dated January 23, 2026), published on the town's official website: Article 1 lists the three-year selectboard seat held by McDowell for election at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting. No official source publishes the outcome, so her seat is not recorded as filled.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kristin Atwood as Town Clerk of Barton.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Kristin Atwood as Town Clerk of Barton.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists 'Clerk: Kristin M. Atwood' with a term expiring 2028; the town's Report of Annual Meeting 2025 records her elected to a three-year term as Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Kristin Atwood as Town Treasurer of Barton.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists 'Treasurer: Kristin M. Atwood' with a term expiring 2028; the town's Report of Annual Meeting 2025 records her elected to a three-year term as Treasurer, separately from the clerkship. The Secretary of State's treasurer contact spreadsheet prints no Barton treasurer ('Contact Town Clerk for more information').

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists 'Tax Collector: Shelia Martin' with a term expiring 2028 among the town's elected officers.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists 'Moderator: Jesse Coe' with a term expiring 2026.

Town of Barton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (dated January 23, 2026), published on the town's official website: Article 1 lists the moderator election at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting with Coe as incumbent. No official source publishes the outcome, so no holder is recorded.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: lists 'First Constable: Tom Lowell' with a term expiring 2026.

Town of Barton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (dated January 23, 2026), published on the town's official website: Article 1 lists the first constable election at the March 3, 2026 annual meeting with Lowell as incumbent. No official source publishes the outcome, so no holder is recorded.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: shows the grand juror office as 'Vacant.'

Town of Barton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (dated January 23, 2026), published on the town's official website: Article 1 lists the grand juror office as vacant for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent to prosecute and defend suits at annual town meeting.

Town of Barton, Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025, 'Elected Town Officers -- For the Year 2025' table (report page 12), published on the town's official website: shows the town agent office with no name (vacant).

Town of Barton, Warning for the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (dated January 23, 2026), published on the town's official website: Article 1 lists the town agent office as vacant for the March 3, 2026 annual meeting.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists eight Barton justices of the peace. The listing spells the name 'Sheila Martin'; the Barton Village officers page and the town report spell the same officeholder's name 'Shelia Martin,' which is the form recorded for the person.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists eight Barton justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
